name: Garnet Cradle - Sugary Sparkle
source:
Fan disc of Garnet Cradle.

When she wakes up, she finds herself being in a crystal ball.... She is very very small and confined in a hard ball.... There is a prince in front of her. He is surprised to see her, but he doesn't know what's going on.... A messenger suddenly appears in front of them and tells them that she is confined in the ball because the prince did something extremely evil.... The messenger also says him, "If you want to save her, you'll need to complete a Christmas tree that is one and only in the world. If you can't, she will be confined in the ball forever...."

[From Himeyashop]
translation:
《Garnet Cradle》的Fan Disc。

她醒來時，發現自己竟被困在一顆水晶球裡……身體變得極其微小，被封在堅硬的球體之中……一位王子站在她面前。看到她時，他驚訝萬分，卻也不明白發生了什麼……一名使者突然現身，告訴二人，她之所以被困在球裡，是因為王子做了極其邪惡的事……使者還對他說：「如果想救她，就必須完成一棵獨一無二的耶誕樹。做不到的話，她將永遠被關在球裡……」

[摘自Himeyashop]
